facts.fact: ch20 开场：夜里的罗马街头在打仗
facts.anchor: Now, by night, there is fighting on the streets of Rome

facts.fact: 一位知名心理学家/教育专家「被醉驾撞死」——官方版本
facts.anchor: A noted psychologist, an expert in pedagogy, is found dead, hit by a drunk driver

facts.fact: 死者实为海盗：多年主张压抑儿童冲动、没收玩具与好奇
facts.anchor: The psychologist was one of the worst of pirates: for years he had argued for the repression of children’s impulses

facts.fact: 真相：双子开一辆旧 Talbot 全速撞死了他
facts.anchor: the Twins, as sober as they’re capable of being, hit him with an old Talbot driven at full throttle

facts.fact: 博尔盖塞庄园一战：三名孩子与两名海盗战死
facts.anchor: A troop of Lost Children and one of pirates battled at Villa Borghese. Three children died, two pirates with them

facts.fact: 两家都哀悼；旁人看刀剑伤口疑有撒旦教
facts.anchor: seeing the wounds left by daggers and swords

facts.fact: 以恐惧驯童的神父 Tonio 被发现死在祭台上
facts.anchor: Father Tonio, an old sadist who spent his life instilling a sacred fear of hell, sex, and masturbation into children, is found dead on the altar of his church one morning

facts.fact: 他被一把厨房刀钉死在祭台
facts.anchor: impaled with a kitchen knife

facts.fact: Hook 的人洗劫 Cavaterra 空宅、找到暗室但无 Michele 线索
facts.anchor: They ransack the rooms from top to bottom, they discover the Secret, but they don’t find clues that would lead them to Michele

facts.fact: 本城中海盗 many
facts.anchor: In this city there are many pirates

facts.fact: 而 Lost 的数目在增长
facts.anchor: In this city the numbers of the Lost are growing

facts.fact: ch20 二节：Nemi 神庙里 Irene 迎风而立督训
facts.anchor: Irene is standing, careless of the wind sweeping through the temple

facts.fact: 林中比城里冷、空气纯净到难呼吸
facts.anchor: It’s colder in the wood than it ever is in town: the air is almost too pure to breathe

facts.fact: Irene 连续三天让 Michele 做同一功课：静坐不动
facts.anchor: For three days Irene has been making him do the same exercise: stay still

facts.fact: 他发现自己身体每刻都在小抽动、眨眼——不受己有
facts.anchor: his body performs every moment

facts.fact: Irene 点出题旨：你几乎不掌控身体、不认识自己、谈不上自由
facts.anchor: how little you control your body. How little you know your self, how barely free you are

facts.fact: Irene 用 Yoda 台词纠正他的 try
facts.anchor: In the original trilogy, Master Yoda says something to Luke Skywalker: ‘Do or do not, there is no try.’

facts.fact: Irene 反击 Michele 的「好莱坞」讥讽：你跟排气管说话还笑我引电影
facts.anchor: You talk to tailpipes and criticise me because I quote a film?

facts.fact: 观想火焰他入门即成——Dream 的启蒙总算有用
facts.anchor: Michele managed it right from the outset—the initiation in Dream had been good for something

facts.fact: 暴雨中静坐结束，Irene 揭穿时长：他以为一分钟，实则半小时
facts.anchor: You stayed still for half an hour

facts.fact: 三节：回家开门瞬间电话响——Greta 到 Nemi
facts.anchor: The moment that Irene opens the door, Michele’s phone rings

facts.fact: Irene 求他谨慎
facts.anchor: Discretion. I don’t doubt she’s a nice girl, but…

facts.fact: Irene 指定洞窟酒吧为安全场所
facts.anchor: Take her to the bar with the cave, that’s a safe place

facts.fact: 四节：Michele 钱包只剩 12.23 欧仍充阔请客
facts.anchor: he has twelve euros and twenty-three cents left in his wallet

facts.fact: 食宿全由 Irene 供，他不好意思再要零花钱
facts.anchor: Irene provides for food and everything, but he’s embarrassed to ask her for pocket money

facts.fact: 校外报道称案件牵涉撒旦教
facts.anchor: They say there’s a Satanic cult involved

facts.fact: Dal Mare 公开称找到线索怀疑有教团
facts.anchor: Dal Mare said he’d found clues that make him suspect something like that

facts.fact: 公众记忆里最后见到的是被打伤、在 campo dè fior 脱衣的 Angela
facts.anchor: the last one anyone saw was your sister, all beaten up, stripping in the Campo de’ Fiori

facts.fact: 校长集会号召知情者举报
facts.anchor: At assembly yesterday the principal said that if anyone knows where you are, for your own good, they have to talk

facts.fact: Michele 咽下的真答案是：我要杀 Dal Mare
facts.anchor: To kill Augusto Dal Mare is not an answer he can spell out

facts.fact: 他权衡信任：Irene 没见过 Greta 当日风雨中来
facts.anchor: But Irene doesn’t know Greta, didn’t see her come back to him despite the scene with Papa

facts.fact: 决定：信任，无疑
facts.anchor: trust the girl he loves or not? The answer is yes, without doubt

facts.fact: 他给出的半真相：Dal Mare 杀了妈妈并藏尸
facts.anchor: He killed Mama,” he answers, “and he hid the body.

facts.fact: 五节：Wedge 在 Dream 奔走寻 Michele
facts.anchor: In Dream, Wedge runs. Limbs that were once human carry him from person to person, from smell to smell

facts.fact: 数周来 shaman 气味追踪无果，他怕再被罚
facts.anchor: the smell of that little freak has faded into nothing

facts.fact: 他找到一条草莓与唇蜜味的梦：金发女孩（Greta）拯救 fugitive
facts.anchor: It’s a dream scented of strawberry and lip gloss, with a brave blonde and a mysterious fugitive

facts.fact: 梦里 Dal Mare 带警察在火刑前救场——祭的是羊头偶像
facts.anchor: Augusto Dal Mare enters the clearing surrounded by police officers, just before Michele gets burned alive before a goat-headed idol

facts.fact: 作者的判语：她在梦里已经泄了密
facts.anchor: for now the girl doesn’t intend to betray her friend. In Dream she already has

facts.fact: 六节：Irene 面色憔悴
facts.anchor: This morning Irene’s face is drawn

facts.fact: 她宣布必须很快转移
facts.anchor: I’m afraid that we’ll have to leave soon

facts.fact: Irene 的名句：恋爱中的男人是世上最危险的生物
facts.anchor: No, I don’t trust you, because you’re a man in love and that makes you the most dangerous creature in the world

facts.fact: Dal Mare 无耻地榨取新闻热度
facts.anchor: Augusto Dal Mare is milking it shamelessly

facts.fact: 她从水占中看见了追兵
facts.anchor: I saw them coming, in the water

facts.fact: 前夜 Michele 闻到烟雾：Irene 在香炉与银盆水前凝视
facts.anchor: A handful of herbs was burning in a little thurible. Beside it Irene was gazing intently into a silver basin of water

facts.fact: 水占所见：海盗来了、他被掳、她死——但未来未写定
facts.anchor: The pirates came. They took you and I died. But the future is always unwritten: it’s just one possibility

facts.fact: Irene 对己死的达观：若必须，便会是；除此之外唯尽力避免
facts.anchor: If it must be, it’ll be. Other than strive for it not to be, there’s nothing I can do

facts.fact: 当日课改讲出体
facts.anchor: what do you know about astral travel?

facts.fact: 头夹双膝倒立位据称能看破 Enchantment 造物之幻
facts.anchor: It’s said this position helps one see the creatures of Enchantment, and to look past the illusions they create

facts.fact: 那些造物早已离去、如今返回
facts.anchor: They went away long ago. Now, though, they’re coming back

facts.fact: 回宅时 Irene 直觉屋内有人的
facts.anchor: Irene notices from the street, even though the door is shut and there’s no sign of forced entry

facts.fact: Michele 凝神听见窸窣、吱呀、呼吸
facts.anchor: Rustles, creaks, breathing rise into the silence

facts.fact: Irene 低声念希腊语祷词
facts.anchor: She murmurs words in Greek

facts.fact: 她向 Hecate 致谢——月下之术是借来的神恩
facts.anchor: Thank you, Hecate, I am in your debt

facts.fact: 弯后三辆车设路障
facts.anchor: the road is blocked by three cars

facts.fact: 五海盗张五弓放五箭
facts.anchor: five bows, and loosing five arrows

facts.fact: 箭把她钉在座椅上，几乎瞬间死亡
facts.anchor: The arrows have impaled her, nailing her to the seat. There wasn’t time for even a breath: Irene must have died instantly

facts.fact: Michele 刚学会爱她又失去她——他拒绝哭给 Dal Mare 看
facts.anchor: He had just begun to love her, and they’ve taken her away from him too

facts.fact: 母城之灵到场许诺撕碎敌人
facts.anchor: We’re here, say the spirits of Mother City. We’ll break their bones

facts.fact: 但灵在罗马才有力量，此路荒野他仍孤身
facts.anchor: In Rome they could make the difference. Here, on a road in the middle of nowhere, Michele is once more alone

facts.fact: 他被迫越过 Irene 的尸体下车
facts.anchor: Michele is forced to climb over Irene’s body to get out into the open

facts.fact: 林中一声吼：一海盗的头被爪削落
facts.anchor: One of the pirates raises his head—a claw swipe rips it off

facts.fact: 救场者上半身似人：巨口、有角、长爪
facts.anchor: there’s something human from the waist up, even though it has a disproportionately-sized mouth, horns, and long claws

facts.fact: 腰以下是多毛兽身：羊腿、尾、巨生殖器
facts.anchor: From the waist down it’s a hairy animal, with goat legs, tail, and a penis of grotesque proportions

facts.fact: 它欢快地撕打，不留任何痛与惧
facts.anchor: It fights gleefully, sparing its enemies nothing, neither pain nor fear

facts.fact: 与两界叠影不同：这是 Flesh 日常现实里长出噩梦
facts.anchor: there are no superimpositions of worlds, this is Flesh, his day-to-day reality, birthing nightmares

facts.fact: 章末揭示：它是 Michele 的外公
facts.anchor: Michele,” it says, “aren’t you going to say hello to your grandfather?
